svg.title: S&P 500 response to the September 2013 Fed announcement
svg.desc: Original published vector geometry: the S&P 500 rises sharply at 14:00 US Eastern. Opening and closing values are 1,705.48 and 1,725.52. The chart does not measure millisecond response.
